summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of 'Achados da Web' deals curation website. All interactive functionality verified including search, filters, responsiveness, and countdown timer.
passed_tests: Real-time search by product name (tested 'Fone' - returned 2 products)
Real-time search by store name (tested 'Shopee' - returned 3 products)
Real-time search by category (tested 'Tech' - returned 3 products)
No results handling with clear filters button (tested 'Xbox' search)
Category filter buttons - Todos (8 products), Tech (3), Moda (3), Casa (1), Beleza (1)
Responsive grid layout - Mobile: 2 columns, Tablet: 3 columns, Desktop: 4 columns
Store badges with correct colors - Shopee (orange), Shein (pink), TikTok Shop (black), AliExpress (red)
Discount badges visible on all product cards (-75%, -60%, -62%, -63%)
Hero section with featured product and countdown timer
Hover effects on product cards and buttons
Button interactions - All CTA buttons clickable
Countdown timer functionality - Visual confirmation of time updates
Clear filters functionality - Resets search and category to show all products
